basic_info.description: NEW PRICE! Fully Detached,Enchanting 1924 Craftsman home in a prime walk-to location, just moments from Bernal Heights village yet offering a serene oasis. Herringbone wood floors, a spacious kitchen with custom cabinetry and granite countertops, and a bathroom featuring subway tile and slate flooring. Garage parking, ample storage, and a magical Zen garden complete this lovely home.
